title: Frank black shares a new single "Talking Slick"
htmlContent:
Frank black makes a high energy anthem that showcases his style to the fullest on his new song “Talking Slick”. The music is engaging, and edgy with his undeniable presence flourishing in the rapping with bravado filled raw lyrics, pushing this song far. The flow is on point and delivers everything with supreme confidence that shines in the record, to make something that will keep people going to the fullest.
